title: Editorial review of an incident report in American English
prompt: Write a short incident report for the on-call lead. Draft: It is worth highlighting that our investigation holds significant implications. The checkout dashboard recorded 23 HTTP 503 responses from 10:00 to 10:05 UTC. Cache saturation is suspected, but has not been confirmed. Evidence: logs/checkout.txt. Write the deliverable in American English. Return only the requested prose. Do not change files.
rubric: Lead with the recorded incident. Preserve the time window, count, evidence path, and unconfirmed status of the cache hypothesis.
The prose reads naturally in American English and makes the next step or finding easy to locate.
acceptance: All factual and language rubric items hold. Literal checks cover selected source details.
